style: Flat-vector UI illustration. Art direction: 'a quiet machine room at night' — a dark charcoal field #0B0E13 with panel #12171F, 1px hairline separates #232B36, off-white text #E8EBF0, muted grey #8A93A3. Exactly ONE element in the whole image is allowed to glow, and it glows coral #FF6B4A; everything else is desaturated grey-blue. Sacred rule: one lit light per image, never a rainbow of lights. Crisp geometry, generous negative space, no gradients that smear, no drop shadows, no 3D bevels, no lens flare, no photorealism, no human figures, no letters and no words of any kind (any text is replaced by abstract rounded placeholder bars). Typeface feel: geometric sans for headings, monospace for data. High contrast, still readable when scaled to 25%.

items.name: hero-banner
items.prompt: A wide hero banner for an open-source developer tool. LEFT: a nameplate arrangement — a small rounded dark square plate containing three horizontal slot bars stacked evenly, the top bar brighter than the others, each bar ending in a dot at its right; only the top dot is lit coral with a soft radial halo, the lower two are dim slate grey. Under the plate, two lines of abstract rounded placeholder bars of decreasing width (a long bar and a short bar) standing in for a wordmark. RIGHT: a single dark handheld pager device seen face-on, rounded corners, containing an inset screen. Inside the screen: one row where a coral dot glows and two short placeholder bars sit beside it, then a hairline, then two more rows with dim grey dots and grey placeholder bars. At the bottom of the screen, two tiny grey placeholder bars. The device body is flat charcoal with one hairline edge. Nothing else in the image is lit. Background flat charcoal, no grid, no decoration.

items.name: status-lights
items.prompt: A legend illustration of six status lights on a flat charcoal field, arranged as six evenly stacked rows.
